purpose: Section 1.2 and section 6.1 of docs/readiness/2026-09-07-cross-carrier-silence-tail-v1-preregistration.md, exposure row SAEA-SN-DEV1000-TS2-PREPROCESS-V1: materialize the featcache encoder packets for the @ts2 media variant of the sealed DEV-1000 comparator population (1,000 rows, 4,884.794 audio seconds, dataset fragment slurp-speech-native-dev1000-tail2s, split identity 9f78d0ff). The scope is the WHOLE fragment and that is MEASURED, not assumed: the legacy feature-cache key is core.model.speech_features.legacy_audio_feature_cache_key, FNV-1a over the ORIGINAL media bytes, so every @ts2 file is a cache miss by construction and none of the comparator's 1,000 promoted packets can be reused or re-touched. Label-free: the CPU-only sidecar (-ngl 0 --no-mmproj-offload, decoder AND bf16 mmproj, runtime-q4km-preprocess.json, port 8081) is driven with one contact per row at max_tokens 1 under the fixed minimal instruction; the cache key is the media bytes ALONE, so the prompt cannot affect the cached features and no response is read semantically. No gold, sentence, transcript, scenario, action, intent, entity or score is opened. Zero GPU-hours: the GPU inference port 8080 is never touched. Promotion into the @ts2 packet root happens only after a verified normal sidecar stop; SAEA-SN-DEV1000-PREPROCESS (2026-08-24) and SAEA-SLURP-EVO-FOLD-PACKETS-V2 (2026-09-06) are the precedents copied.
gate_before_the_thousand: A 4-row dry run of the encode runs FIRST and the full pass proceeds only if it passes: the libsndfile-written FLAC must decode in llama.cpp's miniaudio front end, and the promoted packet's token count must equal the sealed packet's plus the tail's blocks. Four contacts, not a thousand, if it is wrong. The 4 rows are inside the 1,000 and are counted in the registered ceiling, which is 1,004.
what_it_does_not_prove: that the CPU sidecar and the GPU mmproj emit identical features. They are the same graph and the same weights, and the comparator's OWN packets were produced by this same sidecar, so both arms of the cell are encoded by the same instrument -- but no bit-exactness claim is made or needed.
what_this_buys: the cell then flies on the comparator's own serving path -- mmproj-free decode over packets at -c 65536 -np 8 through configs/model/q4km-mmproj-free-speech-native-np8-ts2-packets-max64.json, which is the comparator's model fragment byte for byte except speech_feature_root -- so the contrast against the sealed DEV-1000 rows is single-factor in the media and in nothing else.
authorizes: this fragment authorizes nothing by itself. The row SAEA-SN-DEV1000-TS2-PREPROCESS-V1 must be written to docs/exposure-ledger.md before the first contact, and the cell it enables (SAEA-SLURP-DEV1000-CLOSED-LIST-TAIL2S-V1) is a separate registration with its own owner GO.
after_promotion: the cell's baseline fragment must then pin THIS promotion receipt and its sha256 (configs/baseline/slurp-direct-closed-list.json pins the comparator's DEV-1000 receipt, and core.flight.FlightRuntime._speech_feature_root refuses a speech_feature_root that disagrees with the pinned receipt's feature_root). That fragment cannot be written before the receipt exists, so writing it and re-running scripts/cross_carrier_tail2s_wire_check.py to reach seal_and_score OK on the SLURP cells is the flight agent's step, not this one's.
